title: Tracking residential dwelling conversions across Canada
summary: New dwellings from building conversions in Canada more than doubled from 2018 to 2025, rising to more than 10% of all new dwellings in issued building permits.

changelog.note: Moved from the gentle-density project site and updated to permits issued from 2018 to 2025, from Statistics Canada table 34-10-0292-01, which replaced the archived table 34-10-0285-01.
